embeddings.title: Kulungele amadokhumenti akho
embeddings.description: Kuhlelwa amafayela afakiwe ukuze akwazi ukufunwa nokucitshwe. Lokhu kungathatha umzuzu kumadokhumenti amakhulu.

creation.configure: Khetha imodeli yefu ngokhiye wayo we-API, noma lungiselela injini yendawo ekhethiwe kanye namafayela ayo adingekayo kuzilungiselelo Zokudala.
creation.localNote: Izithombe zasendaweni zisebenzisa ifolda ye-Diffusers ephelele, izingxenye ezihlukene ze-GGUF/Safetensors ezine-stable-diffusion.cpp, noma izisindo zomdabu ze-NVFP4 CUDA ezinePython 3.15.1. Ividiyo isebenzisa ama-Diffusers. Izinketho ze-CPU/GPU zihlukene kusifaki khodi kanye nejeneretha yezithombe ezinjinini ezisekelwe esakhiweni.
creation.autosave: Izithombe namavidiyo aqediwe alondolozwa ngokuzenzakalelayo kumafolda e-Novera ahlukene ngaphakathi kwamafolda ezithombe namavidiyo wesistimu yakho, nezilungiselelo zawo zokukhiqiza.
creation.autoNote: Ibona ngokuzenzakalelayo izicelo zokudala izithombe ezibekela ingcaca noma amavidiyo ngesi-French nangesiNgisi. Ungahlala uzikhethela ifomethi yokuphumayo.
creation.variantPrompt: Dala inguqulo entsha yalesi sithombe, ugcine isihloko saso esikhulu.
creation.missing: Lokhu okudaliwe kususiwe noma akusatholakali kule khompuyutha.
creation.desktopOnly: Ukwakhiwa kwesithombe nevidiyo ngokulondoloza okuzenzakalelayo kuyatholakala kuhlelo lokusebenza lwedeskithophu.
creation.inputUnsupported: Sebenzisa isithombe esisodwa esisekelwa imodeli ekhethiwe. Okufakwayo kwevidiyo nezithombe zokufaka eziningi azisekelwe lapha.
creation.animatePrompt: Gcwalisa lesi sithombe ngenkathi ulondoloza isihloko saso esiyinhloko.
creation.filterNote: Isithombe nevidiyo zihlunga okukhiphayo okukhiqizwayo. Amamodeli we-Multimodal angaqonda izinhlobo eziningana zokufaka; lokhu akusho ngaso sonke isikhathi ukuthi bangakhiqiza izithombe noma ividiyo.
creation.generationOnly: Le modeli idala imidiya. Ikhethe esigabeni esithi Isithombe noma Sevidiyo.
creation.cloudNote: I-Cloud generation ithumela isithombe sakho esisheshayo nesifakiwe kumhlinzeki okhethiwe futhi ingase ingenise izindleko. Ukuma endaweni angeke kukhansele ukukhokhiswa okukude.
creation.cloudDefaults: Ifu lisebenzisa ukusetha kusengaphambili okuqondene nomhlinzeki. Amapharamitha wendawo asebenza enjinini yokudala yendawo ekhethiwe.
creation.cloudTimeout: Umsebenzi wamafu awuphelanga phakathi nomkhawulo wesikhathi. Hlola isimo sayo nomhlinzeki ngaphambi kokuqala esinye isizukulwane esikhokhelwayo.
creation.adobeCredentials: I-Adobe Firefly idinga ithokheni yokufinyelela kanye nesihlonzi seklayenti sokhiye we-x kuzilungiselelo zomhlinzeki.
creation.catalogNote: Lo mhlinzeki usebenzisa uhlu lwamamodeli anakekelwe. Ukuyivuselela akuqinisekisi ukhiye noma ukufinyelela kwe-akhawunti yakho. Asikho isizukulwane esikhokhelwayo esisetshenziselwa ukuhlola izifakazelo.
creation.ggufTextEncoder: Isifaki khodi sombhalo (GGUF noma ama-Safetensors ahambisanayo)
creation.ggufNote: Khetha imodeli yokusabalalisa, isifaki khodi sombhalo kanye ne-VAE ngokuhlukene. Nge-FLUX.2 Klein 4B, sebenzisa isifaki khodi se-Qwen3-4B esihambisanayo, okuhlanganisa nokuhluka kwayo kwe-GGUF. Amafayela e-NVFP4 asekelwayo alungiswa kanye nge-Python 3.15.1 kanye ne-PyTorch kunqolobane enkulu yokuhambisana; okwangempela kuhlala kungashintshile. Lokhu kudinga isikhala sediski esengeziwe kanye ne-RAM. Gcina i-sd-cli nemitapo yolwazi yayo. I-Auto isebenzisa ihadiwe etholakalayo; I-CUDA idinga ukwakhiwa kwe-CUDA. I-Distilled Klein ivamise ukusebenzisa izinyathelo ezi-4 kanye ne-CFG 1. Azikho izisindo ezilandiwe.
creation.ggufWrongModel: Le GGUF iqukethe isifaki khodi sombhalo. Ikhethe kunkambu yesifaki khodi bese ukhetha imodeli ehlukile yokusabalalisa endaweni yesithombe.
creation.nativeNote: I-NVFP4 CUDA yomdabu: Izisindo ze-FLUX.2 Klein 4B Comfy, Qwen3-4B GGUF encoder kanye ne-FLUX.2 Safetensors VAE. Idinga i-Blackwell (uchungechunge lwe-RTX 50 noma oluhambisanayo), i-Python 3.15.1, i-CUDA PyTorch kanye nokuncika kwe-NVFP4 okungakhethwa. Umbhalo uye esithombeni kuphela. Izingxenyekazi zekhompuyutha ezingasekelwe zehluleka ngokusobala; khetha i-stable-diffusion.cpp ukuze uthole ukuhambisana. Ayikho inqolobane yokusabalalisa ye-BF16.
creation.deviceNote: Lezi zingxenye zinezinketho ezizimele zedivayisi. I-Auto isebenzisa ihadiwe etholakalayo; I-NVFP4 yomdabu ihlale idinga i-GPU ehambisanayo ukuze ikhiqize futhi isebenzisa umbhalo wekhodi we-GPU uma i-VRAM eyanele imahhala. I-Qwen ku-CPU ingonga i-VRAM kodwa ibhala ngekhodi kancane. I-Qwen ku-GPU isebenzisa ukulayisha kwesendlalelo. Ku-stable-diffusion.cpp, i-Auto ilandela injini ekhethiwe; ukuphoqa i-CUDA kudinga ukwakhiwa kwe-CUDA.
creation.totalTimeHint: Isikhathi esiphelele sihlanganisa ukulayisha, ukubhala ngekhodi kombhalo, ukukhiqiza, noma yiliphi ifu elilindile, ukulanda nokulondoloza. Isizukulwane sisodwa sikhonjiswa ngokwehlukana lapho injini ibika ngaso.
creation.recommendedSetupNote: Ukudala ku-GPU, Qwen3-4B ku-CPU, izinyathelo 4, CFG 1. Kuhlolwe ku-Windows/Vulkan; isivinini nokuhambisana kuncike kuzingxenyekazi.
creation.seedNote: Izithombe zendawo kuphela. Qhathanisa ngemodeli nezilungiselelo ezifanayo.
creation.imageResolutionMax: Ukucaca okuphezulu ku-Novera: 2048 × 2048 px. Kudingeka imemori eyanele.
creation.upscaleNote: Ngemva kokukhiqiza. Kudingeka Python/PyTorch. Umphumela omkhulu: ×2 4096 × 4096, ×4 8192 × 8192.
creation.upscaleMissing: Faka amamodeli noma ukhethe ifayela le-.pth elihambisanayo bese uhlola Python/PyTorch.

creationInstall.confirm: Landa lawa mafayela kule folda? Kusebenza amalayisensi abahlinzeki.
creationInstall.background: Ungaqhubeka nokuxoxa nokudala izithombe noma amavidiyo ngesikhathi sokulanda. Landela inqubekela phambili ngesithonjana kubha enkulu.
creationInstall.engine: Injini eyakhelwe ngaphakathi: CUDA / Vulkan / CPU ngokuzenzakalela
creationInstall.note: Ukudala ku-GPU, Qwen3-4B ku-CPU, izinyathelo 4, CFG 1. Kuhlolwe ku-Windows/Vulkan; isivinini nokuhambisana kuncike kuzingxenyekazi.
creationInstall.error: Ukufaka kuhlulekile. Hlola inethiwekhi, indawo, izimvume namalayisensi amamodeli bese uqhubeka.

memory.title: Inkumbulo yamamodeli endawo
memory.autoNote: Ilayisha amamodeli lapho edingeka futhi ikhulule angasasetshenziswa lapho umsebenzi osebenzayo uphela.
memory.manualNote: Umbhalo, izithombe nevidiyo kungasebenza ndawonye ezingxoxweni ezihlukene uma i-RAM/VRAM yanele. Inkumbulo ingaphela.
memory.preserve: Amafayela nezingxoxo ziyagcinwa; amamodeli alayishwa futhi lapho edingeka. Izinguquko zisebenza ezicelweni ezintsha.
memory.failed: Ukulungisa inkumbulo kwehlulekile. Zama futhi noma khetha Okwenziwa ngesandla.
